name: Ikuno
text: Ikuno (生野町, Ikuno-chō) was a town located in Asago District, Japan. As of 2003, the town had an estimated population of 4,872 and a density of 43.50 persons per km2. The total area was 112.01 km2.

depictions.text: Ikuno, Hyōgo Ikuno (福知山城) was a town situated in The Silver Lands in Tamba, Japan.
